WITH channel_averages AS (
  SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
), above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT c.avg_fee_rate, c.avg_fee_rate - b.avg_fee_rate AS excess_rate
  FROM channel_averages AS c
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > b.avg_fee_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS mean_channel_avg_fee_rate,
       AVG(excess_rate) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;

assumptions.assumption: Channels are grouped by orders.orderbase, and only fee records linked to an existing order contribute to channel averages and the overall benchmark. AVG ignores NULL fee rates; NULL orderbase values form one channel group.
